children.prompt: Comment on the accuracy of the mean estimate from a grouped frequency table, compared to the actual mean.

answer.short: The estimate is close: $\$32418.85$ compared with $\$32818.52$. It underestimates the actual mean by about $\$399.66$.
answer.worked: The estimate is close to the actual mean, underestimating it by about $\$399.66$ (about $1.22\%$). Grouping replaces each actual price with its class centre, so the grouped mean is only an estimate.
